title: Reviewers run container-only; sandbox probing removed
summary: The reviewer pipeline stops trying to detect whether osf runs inside the factory container. Codex no longer carries a `--sandbox read-only` mode or a `codex sandbox -- true` pre-flight check; every reviewer now runs with its own sandbox off, because the container is the wall. In exchange, the workflow sets `OSF_KEEP_REVIEW_HOME=1` and points `TMPDIR` at a mounted `out/reviewer-home`, so each reviewer's home survives the run and is uploaded as a diagnostic artifact, with the child's stdout/stderr written into it and any seeded login removed first.

nodes.label: review.yml
nodes.subtitle: three reviewer jobs
nodes.summary: Each reviewer job (codex, claude, opencode) now pre-creates out/reviewer-home, passes OSF_KEEP_REVIEW_HOME=1 and TMPDIR=/out/reviewer-home into the review container, and uploads out/reviewer-home as a review-home-<agent> artifact with if: always().

nodes.label: reviewer job
nodes.subtitle: docker run /osf-bin/osf review run
nodes.summary: The job that runs one reviewer inside the factory image. It gains the two environment variables and the artifact upload step; the container invocation itself is unchanged.

nodes.label: review-home artifact
nodes.subtitle: actions/upload-artifact
nodes.summary: A new artifact per reviewer job holding the kept home: child.stdout, child.stderr and whatever the agent wrote there. Uploaded with if: always() so a failed run still leaves evidence.

nodes.label: reviewer home
nodes.subtitle: out/reviewer-home
nodes.summary: The temporary home a reviewer runs in. Previously always removed on drop; now kept when OSF_KEEP_REVIEW_HOME is set, with the seeded login removed and the child's stdout/stderr written in.

nodes.label: reviewers.rs
nodes.subtitle: roster and run loop
nodes.summary: Loses sandbox_check, check_sandbox, roster_in and the in_container parameter; gains keep_home, preserve_home, exit_reason and last_non_empty_line.

nodes.label: roster()
nodes.subtitle: selects reviewers from osf.toml
nodes.summary: No longer takes a container-detection flag and no longer delegates to roster_in. Each reviewer is built with its own container mode directly.

nodes.label: Reviewer::from_agent
nodes.subtitle: agent -> reviewer
nodes.summary: Drops the in_container argument and the sandbox_check field. read_only is now simply review.in_container.or(review.read_only), so a reviewer with an in-container mode always uses it.

nodes.label: run_one
nodes.subtitle: one reviewer, one answer
nodes.summary: The sandbox pre-flight is removed from run_with_retry, so the agent is spawned directly. The child's stderr is now captured rather than discarded, and a non-zero exit prints its last line to the console while the journalled reason stays generic.

nodes.label: preserve_home
nodes.subtitle: writes the kept home
nodes.summary: When OSF_KEEP_REVIEW_HOME is set, removes each seeded login path from the home and writes child.stdout and child.stderr into it. The home is a record only; nothing decides anything from it.

nodes.label: RunHome::drop
nodes.subtitle: cleanup on scope exit
nodes.summary: Now checks keep_home() first: when set it prints the kept path and returns without removing the directory.

nodes.label: agents.rs
nodes.subtitle: agent definitions
nodes.summary: Loses FACTORY_CONTAINER_MARKER, DOCKER_MARKER, MarkerFacts, marker_trusted, facts_of and in_factory_container, plus the sandbox_check field on Review.

nodes.label: codex
nodes.subtitle: no read-only mode
nodes.summary: read_only is now None and sandbox_check is gone. Codex always runs with --dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox, and --ephemeral is dropped from its clean-copy switches.

nodes.label: claude
nodes.subtitle: unchanged mode
nodes.summary: Keeps its file-tool-only read-only mode; only the now-removed sandbox_check field disappears from its Review.

nodes.label: opencode
nodes.subtitle: unchanged mode
nodes.summary: Keeps its read-only mode; only the sandbox_check field disappears.

nodes.label: reviewer tests
nodes.subtitle: reviewers.rs, review_run.rs, review_workflow.rs
nodes.summary: The sandbox-check tests, the container-marker tests and the outside-the-container codex tests are deleted; the remaining tests assert codex always runs with the bypass flag and no read-only mode.
